intro: One of the songs he wrote in late 1965, between the electric tours. He tried it first as a band song, then found the slow, drifting version in Nashville.

lives.title: "Freeze Out" with the Hawks
lives.note: Cut fast and edgy with the band he was touring with, under the working title Freeze Out. Released on No Direction Home and The Cutting Edge.

lives.title: The Nashville master
lives.note: Slowed right down with Nashville session players and Al Kooper's organ. On Blonde on Blonde, June 1966.

lives.title: Solo in 1966
lives.note: Played alone with guitar and harmonica in the hushed first half of the 1966 shows. On The Bootleg Series Vol. 4.

lives.title: Late revival
lives.note: Rarely played for decades, it came back often in 2012 and 2013.

others.note: Took it into their own live sets from 1986.
